DEMONSTRATION FIXTURE - FICTIONAL. This text was written for testing the TotalMarket newsroom and is not an RBI publication.
Monetary policy statement (fictional test data)
Date: 5 December 2026
The Monetary Policy Committee decided today to lower the policy repo rate by 25 basis points, from 6.50 per cent to 6.25 per cent, with immediate effect.
4 members voted in favour of the decision and 2 members voted against it.
The Governor said: "The committee will remain watchful of the evolving inflation outlook."
